MEGA-EUR.summary: No current, directly corroborated MEGA/MegaETH exploit, network outage, exchange maintenance/delisting, regulatory action, or imminent confirmed supply event was found. Monitor KPI-triggered emissions and the late-October Fluffle vesting completion.

facts.fact: MEGA/EUR identifies as MegaETH’s MEGA token; OKX officially added the MEGA/EUR spot pair on April 30, 2026. ([okx.com](https://www.okx.com/cs/help/okx-will-launch-mega-usd-and-mega-eur-for-spot-trading?utm_source=openai))

MegaETH states that 53% of MEGA supply is reserved for KPI-based distributions that can be released when milestones are achieved and attested, rather than on fixed dates. No new attestation was found in the current search. ([megaeth.com](https://www.megaeth.com/token?utm_source=openai))

The official allocation page says the remaining Fluffle allocation vests over six months after April 30, 2026; a third-party vesting tracker lists an October 30, 2026 event, so this is a near-term supply-monitoring item rather than a confirmed immediate event. ([megaeth.com](https://www.megaeth.com/token?utm_source=openai))

A live impersonation/drainer domain targeting MegaETH users was reported, but this is a phishing risk to wallet users—not evidence of a compromise of MegaETH, MEGA, or the MEGA/EUR market. ([phishdestroy.io](https://phishdestroy.io/domain/ecosystem-megaeth.app/?utm_source=openai))
